decision.L2: Defect L2 useful location+cause rate AND strict location+cause/no false claim/no concrete repair rate each strictly exceed both BASE and V1.
decision.L3: Defect L3 cause+feasible repair >=2/6 and strictly exceeds both BASE and V1.
decision.completion: All 60 requests complete and all relevant semantic flags known for BASE,V1,V2.
decision.failure: Any failed or unknown condition => keep R15; no retuning or further training, no public candidate.
decision.false_claims: Overall V2 false claims <=V1 and <BASE; L1 false-clean <=V1.
decision.public: No public generation authorized by this protocol.
decision.taxonomy: For each source/annotation micro/macro F1: V2 >= BASE + .9*max(0,V1-BASE).

limitations: Development and family prior exposure; not blind or family-disjoint.
Static agent review, not human verified; compiler/testcase execution zero.
Validation parsed output objects unchanged; v2 JSON serialization orders feedback before taxonomy, unlike v1. No across-run CE comparability.
Lexical identity gates do not prove absence of every semantic duplicate.
No L4 supervision or L4 improvement claim.
